cases.name: First read saves and returns one synthetic immutable assessment
Fresh readers see the exact saved facts, assessment, decisions and hash
Concurrent readers cannot replace or duplicate the saved record
Canonical proof cannot be changed or deleted
No private workspace, membership or user approval is created
No write API exists for a recruiter to approve or change the proof
A workspace query cannot make the public reader access a private ID
Saved proof dashboard route renders without a private login requirement

scope: Compiled Worker, local D1 and synthetic records; not professional validation.
